Mint, and a pretty satisfying one, despite how hard it was.

Haka finished the job with the Mere on the next turn.

Heroes were all around 10HP, excpet for Fanatic, who ended lower.

posts.name: Jeysie
posts.cooked:
This one was hard as heck now that I actually tried it proper, but I got a lot of mileage out of recycling Wrathful Retribution twice and of basically having Fanatic give Argent all the power activations who in turn was able to churn out his songs with his base power and then let everyone else play cards off of Inventive Preparation... ironically often to let Fanatic herself play cards.

I thought I was clever and threw out a Rampage late in the game that left the Twisted Miscreations alive... until Zhu Long came along and wiped them out. Figures. But fortunately Infinitor was down to only single digit HP by then anyway so I was still able to live out the villain turn and then finish him off.

Everyone was just barely double digits HP except Cosmic who had 8 and Fanatic who had 2. Ouch. This is what happens when you don't let Fanatic say grace, fellas.
